budget.hardware_limits: Existing current capped/native guards; no replacement of their limits.
budget.procedure_note: fit 1024 steps on TRAIN256, curve 4096 steps on the first 4096 eligible rows; CONTROL4096 observed at 0 and 4096 (operator decision 12.10.2026)

calendar.owner_note: the frozen calendar, bindings and CONTROL256 are owned by the design produced in NATIVE_PREPARATION_001 from LEARNING_PREPARATION_001/INPUT_DESIGN.json; these windows are repeated for reading only

decision.economic_required: Separate cost-adjusted all-selected and one-position portfolio evidence beyond relevant same-risk baselines with uncertainty and open-position accounting.
decision.failure: Preserve results and reject expansion; no same-control retuning, extra steps, thresholds or automatic restart.
decision.later_required: Every predeclared Entry/Exit-by-side aggregate paired MSE contrast versus initial and TRAIN constant has negative upper95percent week-block bound; report monthly conflicts and action collapse. Missing or ambiguous evidence is not GO.
decision.success_limit: Bounded minimum Entry-only learning evidence on the 20-day target only. Independent later generalization, train/serve parity, more seeds, Entry-preserving Exit training and offline operational qualification remain required.
decision.training_required: Entry LONG/SHORT improve over initial and same-TRAIN constants with centered error and state-dependent predictions on the 20-day target; pure mean shift or all-FLAT does not pass.

hypothesis: One bounded fresh native v10 Entry-only fit on the NATIVE_D1 generation (315 signal fields with the ninth D1 macro/positioning context family, five timeframes) learns state-dependent observed 20-trading-day market value on the frozen eligible TRAIN rows and transfers to the fixed later development control beyond initialization and same-TRAIN constants. 1 and 5 trading days are observed on the same rows, never optimized. This does not isolate the marginal effect of the D1 family.

implementation_blockers.observed: P0 code (horizon learning design, dataset keys, trainer dispatch, learning study v2) and P1a (coordinates v2 over the eligible subset) are committed; P1 preparation stages and the GPU campaign remain to run.

initialization.ema: Fresh copy and existing horizon rule from actual eligible TRAIN population.
initialization.online: Fresh current v38 constructor with all shared modules; no inherited weights or optimizer.
initialization.optimizer: Existing AdamW groups: lr0.0001,weight_decay0.0001,batch16,grad_accum1; existing scheduler and trainable task weighting.
initialization.selection_variant: ONLINE at exactly256 optimizer steps; no best-checkpoint, EMA selection or automatic extension.
initialization.target: Frozen copy of the same current initial ONLINE function and weights. Do not strip current parameter-free norms for historical compatibility. Bind function identity as well as state hashes.

measurements.economic: After learning gate, separately bind native policy evaluation and portfolio accounting, all selected trades, open executable marks, actual costs and one-position capacity; compare FLAT and preselected same-risk always-LONG. No economic claim from teacher MSE or from only closed winners.
measurements.later_control: Same paired outputs and TRAIN constants on the locked CONTROL4096 drawn from the complete-horizon VAL population at steps 0 and 4096; MSE and rank-IC per horizon; report each calendar month and week without choosing a favorable subset.
measurements.training: Paired fresh-initial/fixed-final ONLINE on TRAIN256 (fit phase, 1024 steps) and the first 4096 eligible rows (curve phase, 4096 steps) with identical frozen 20-day targets. Entry LONG/SHORT MSE, centered MSE, contrast MSE, action distributions and rank-IC per horizon. Baseline constants fitted from the same TRAIN only. Exit heads are not trained in this phase.
measurements.uncertainty: Existing fixed paired calendar-week block bootstrap:5000 draws,seed20260911. Descriptive reused-development uncertainty, not pristine OOS.

selection.control: existing deterministic_uniform_subsample_indices over the time-sorted physical VAL rows with complete observed outcomes at every trading-day horizon at or before the measured val eligibility cutoff (availability only, never outcome values)
selection.missing_control_targets: Control IDs are drawn only from rows with complete horizon outcomes; never replace IDs after inspecting outcomes. A censored row inside the eligible population fails closed.
selection.train: existing native epoch0 order over the entire physical TRAIN population, filtered to the eligible rows (complete observed outcomes at every trading-day horizon at or before the measured TRAIN eligibility cutoff) before taking the first 4096; no outcome ranking
selection.training_probe: Freeze256 from the actual planned4096 with the existing selector salt0 after target-clock eligibility. No optimizer before this is bound.

targets.auxiliary_heads: All existing genuine objectives retained with exact TRAIN-owned policy and complete target-support bindings. No new loss-weight or threshold search.
targets.economics_authority: Existing native net-economics and cost owners must be bound before target generation; report financing proxy and capital hurdle separately. No stale bundle or relabeled policy receipt.
targets.entry: Independent observed executable BID/ASK markout net of the declared cost owner at 20 trading days on the session clock (owner gx1/contracts/entry_observed_market_horizons_v1.py, learning design configs/research/NATIVE_ENTRY_OBSERVED_HORIZONS_20261012.json); FLAT=0; 1 and 5 trading days observed only. No Exit-model target.
targets.entry_exit_consistency: Entry-only optimizer phase entry_only_observed_horizon_20d; Exit receives no gradients and keeps its existing reference policy, clocks and net cost authority. Use existing target owners.
targets.exit: Liquidation-relative Q_mu HOLD from existing analytical reference trace, actual net economic rewards and frozen boundary teacher; EXIT_NOW=0. Preserve signed values, masks and decomposition.
targets.limitations: Observed terminal cash outcome at one declared horizon under declared costs, not optimal exit, learned-policy profit or proven edge; a horizon is an observation window, never a holding-time rule.

temporal_contract.control: CONTROL256 and CONTROL4096 targets use only declared physical VAL support ending before 2026-07-01; every 20-day exit of a control row lies inside the VAL window (measured val cutoff 2026-06-02T23:55Z). No updates to normalization, thresholds or model.
temporal_contract.feature_fits: Existing registry and squeeze fit windows end2013; all upstream fitted feature contracts must end before this control cutoff.
temporal_contract.input_context: Only authoritative closed bars available at each decision. Earlier context may be read, never future decision inputs.
temporal_contract.normalization: Fit once on the entire explicitly eligible physical TRAIN population before optimizer sampling, with existing deduplicated base/context/MTF/lifetime owners; zero physical VAL/TEST fit rows. Do not fit on only the4096 sampled Entries.
temporal_contract.supervision: Every TRAIN observed-horizon outcome must close at or before the TRAIN/control cutoff 2025-06-01; the frozen eligible TRAIN rows end at the measured cutoff 2025-05-02T19:20Z (20 trading days = 28 to 32 calendar days). Rows without a closed M1 bar at the entry's session offset in the target session are censored: excluded and counted, never filled.
temporal_contract.trading: These boundaries limit information for learning and measurement; they are not maximum holding times or forced liquidation rules.

measured_entry_eligibility.method: complete observed outcomes at every trading-day horizon; cutoff = last complete decision time per split, measured 12.10.2026 on the NATIVE_D1 dataset (availability only)

source_owners_note: sha256 of the named owners at source_commit; pruned files from the V38 declaration are omitted
